title: services.packages.adjust_grant params
description: Gives a SOLD voucher more sessions and/or a later expiry as a courtesy (services#118): «one more session on the house», «extended a month because we were closed». It is written as a movement with who, when and why; the purchase itself is never rewritten. Sessions only on a voucher with a session limit, days only on one that expires. It moves NO money and issues no fiscal document.

grant_id.description: Id of the grant (the voucher purchase) being adjusted.

uses_delta.description: Sessions added to what the customer has left.

reason.description: Why, in the operator's words. Mandatory: it stays in the voucher's movements.
